source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: [Tunnelling Horrors](vsdata:ability/necrons.ophydian-destroyers.tunnelling-horrors) can put **unengaged** Ophydian Destroyers into **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** as the enemy turn ends. Use an **[Ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move)** to return them on your immediately following [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase).
